AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (28 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

Review SMB Team's proposal and Rick Rye's decision.

Key Takeaways

Decision: Rick Rye will postpone the $5k/mo commitment until early January 2026 due to immediate cash flow needs, not a lack of belief in the value.

Rationale: The firm is managing ~$60k CAD in year-end expenses (taxes, prior investments) and has ~$50k in unbilled AR to collect first.

Path Forward: SMB Team will help collect the AR upon engagement, but Rye prefers to clear his financial deck first to ensure a fully committed, successful partnership.

Topics

Financial Constraints & Timeline

Rye confirmed strong interest in SMB Team's services but cited immediate financial constraints as the reason for the delay.

Primary Hurdles:

~$60k CAD in year-end expenses (taxes, prior investments).

~$50k in unbilled AR to collect.

Proposed Timeline:

Now–Jan 2026: Rye will focus on collecting AR and clearing expenses.

Early Jan 2026: Target date for a firm commitment to the $5k/mo package.

SMB Team's Value Proposition

Martinez positioned the service as an investment with a rapid ROI, not a simple expense.

Key Metrics & Guarantees:

Time Savings: Recoup 10–12 hours/week in the first 30 days.

ROI: Annual spend recouped in 2–3 months.

Revenue Growth: 81% average annual growth for first-year clients (vs. 5% industry average).

Guarantee: Double investment back (Rye noted enforceability concerns in Canada).

Rye's Perspective:

Views the service as a "supercharge" for his practice, not just a lead-gen tool.

Needs to be in a "100% comfortable" financial position to ensure full commitment and success.

Firm Operations & Goals

Rye's firm is busy with ~350 active files and a stable team, but he is currently "entrenched" in daily operations.

Primary Goal: Build a scalable business that runs independently, allowing for more personal freedom and less direct management.

Future Vision: Leverage automation and "virtual avatars" to avoid hiring more staff, creating a "sweet spot" for efficiency.

Next Steps

John Martinez:

Send a proposal recap email to Rick Rye.

Follow up with Rick Rye before Thanksgiving to maintain contact.

Send the physical book to the Finch Avenue office (ETA: Nov 12).

Rick Rye:

Focus on collecting outstanding AR and clearing year-end expenses.

Re-engage with John Martinez in early January 2026 to commit to the package.

Action Items

Email Rick meeting recap + SMB Team capabilities/deliverables - WATCH (5 secs)
Ask staff to monitor mail for SMB Team book (green pkg) at 1280 Finch Ave W - WATCH (5 secs)
Follow up w/ Rick re: progress; schedule Jan 1–14 decision call - WATCH (5 secs)
